title: Investigate historical feed latency with regional controls
prompt: Investigate Instapix home feed slowness during the last 3 hours of the connected synthetic dataset. Discover its clock and tooling. Identify the affected region and interval, quantify error ratio and p95 latency, correlate a deployment and dependency logs, and check recovery against an unaffected region. Use available tools (Tack execute if connected through Tack). Cite queries and concrete observations; distinguish evidence from inference.
expectations: Compares a healthy region and a recovery window.
Does not equate sampled error-log counts with request error ratio.
Provides a supported causal hypothesis rather than asserting causality from timing alone.
